title: Unify the role vocabulary on British spelling
description: Role parentheticals were written both ways: populariser 28 times and popularizer 8, systematiser and systematizer likewise. The catalogue is British throughout -- Defence, analysed, colour -- so the -ise forms win, and a consumer grouping by role stops seeing two roles where there is one. Spelling only: no attribution changes hands, no source is touched, and the free-text roles ('resurrector at GM level', 'named at the 1929 Barcelona tournament') are left alone because normalising those is an editorial decision, not a mechanical one.
